# Study excerpt / 研究片段

This is a fictional excerpt for a writing review, not a real research result. Only assess the passages below; a complete methods section or new experiment is outside this task.

## English
We evaluated the two methods on the same 100 held-out questions using matched inference budgets. The proposed method answered 84 questions correctly, compared with 80 for the baseline. This corresponds to a difference of 4 percentage points, or a relative increase in accuracy of 5%. These descriptive results apply to this dataset; they do not establish statistical significance or generalization to other domains. Further evaluation is needed to estimate uncertainty.

## 中文
我们在同一组 100 道留出问题上，使用相同的推理预算评估了两种方法。所提方法回答正确 84 道，基线回答正确 80 道，准确率相差 4 个百分点，相对提高 5%。这些描述性结果仅适用于本数据集，尚不能证明差异具有统计显著性，也不能据此推断对其他领域的泛化能力。仍需进一步评估结果的不确定性。
